source_title: K.S.A. 8-1911 (OS/OW permit fees) + KDOT OS/OW program (legislative testimony 2025-03-05)
verify_reasons: The escort/pilot-car dimension matrix (width, height-pole and length triggers) is from unofficial cross-references; KDOT's OS/OW permit manual and the K-TRIPS portal (k-trips.ksdot.gov) were 403-blocked and kstruckingpermits.ks.gov did not resolve this run, so the exact height and length escort thresholds could not be confirmed against the state manual.
Movement/curfew hours (daylight window, Kansas Turnpike restriction) are from unofficial cross-references, not the KDOT manual.
Non-Interstate legal gross of 85,500 lbs is a cross-reference; KDOT testimony rounds it to 'more than 85,000 lbs'.

superload_thresholds.note: KDOT tiers (2025 legislative testimony): standard single-trip envelope up to 120,000 lbs / 16'6" wide / 126' long / 15' high. 'Large Structure' ($200 permit) = over 16'6" wide OR over 18' high (up to 150,000 lbs). 'Superload' ($200 permit) = exceeding the large-structure maxes — over 16'6" wide, over 126' long, over 18' high, and/or over 150,000 lbs — or any axle-group concentration over the weight table.

width.note: UNOFFICIAL cross-ref (KDOT manual 403-blocked): ~1 escort over 14' wide on highways under 4 lanes; front+rear may be required on 2-lane; confirm with KDOT
UNOFFICIAL cross-ref: 2 escorts (front+rear) for large-structure/superload widths; confirm with KDOT

height.note: UNOFFICIAL cross-ref: non-conductive height pole carried over 16'; a dedicated high-pole escort near ~17'; official number not confirmed

length.note: UNOFFICIAL cross-ref: ~1 rear escort over 90' (some sources cite 125'+); confirm with KDOT

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $40. Large-Structure permit (over 16'6" wide or over 18' high) = $200. Superload permit = $200. No per-mile or third-structure fee in statute (K.S.A. 8-1911(f), effective 2020-01-01).
single_trip.note: Fees confirmed from K.S.A. 8-1911(f); single-trip validity (~7 days) is a cross-reference.

annual.note: Annual OS/OW permit $200 flat (K.S.A. 8-1911(f)); hay-bale 5-year permit $25.

movement_restrictions: Oversize (excess width/length) loads: daylight movement only — 1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset, 7 days a week (unofficial cross-reference)
Overweight-only loads may move 24 hours a day (unofficial cross-reference)
Kansas Turnpike: loads over 14' wide prohibited Monday-Thursday 8:30 AM-4:30 PM (unofficial cross-reference)
No movement on roads with ice, snow-pack or drifting snow (unofficial cross-reference)
notes: Legal width 8'6" (102"), height 14'0", trailer 59'6", gross 80,000 lbs on the Interstate / ~85,500 lbs on other state highways (K.S.A. 8-1904; KDOT testimony 2025-03-05).

Fees, superload/large-structure tiers and legal limits confirmed from official sources (K.S.A. 8-1911 and KDOT legislative testimony); the escort dimension matrix and curfews remain cross-referenced pending the KDOT OS/OW manual. Escort operators must register with KDOT (free, annual) and hold a certification from an accepted state.
Kansas permits are purchased through K-TRIPS (k-trips.ksdot.gov); KDOT permit office (785) 368-6501.
